convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in indicators (4x iMA, 1x iVolumes). Simple market orders with no grid/martingale. Trade.mqh/SymbolInfo.mqh/DealInfo.mqh/PositionInfo.mqh are standard MT5 library includes, not custom logic. Signal logic is straightforward formula comparison.

other_exits: Signal reversal: opposite signal closes current position before opening new one (position_gate ensures only one position at a time)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: if Lots==0 then lot = AccountFreeMargin * MaximumRisk / 1000.0 (normalized), else lot = Lots (fixed)

custom_logic_notes: GO formula simplifies to: GO = 2*(MA_Close - MA_Open)*Volume. The terms (MA_High-MA_Open)+(MA_Low-MA_Open)+(MA_Close-MA_Low)+(MA_Close-MA_High) cancel out leaving only 2*(C-O)*V. Sell order incorrectly uses SolveBuySL/SolveBuyTP instead of SolveSellSL/SolveSellTP (likely bug in original code). StopLoss and TakeProfit are hardcoded to 0 so SL/TP are effectively disabled. CloseLevelDif default is 0, so close level equals open level when default.
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol PERIOD_CURRENT 730 days, default MA period 174 suggests H1 or higher timeframe
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. Compute 4 EMAs (period 174 on Close/Open/High/Low) plus volume, calculate GO = 2*(EMA_Close - EMA_Open) * Volume. Entry: GO > OpenLevel -> long, GO < -OpenLevel -> short. Exit: long closed when GO < (OpenLevel - CloseLevelDif), short closed when GO > -(OpenLevel - CloseLevelDif). Position sizing: if Lots==0 then FreeMargin * MaximumRisk / 1000 normalized to volume step. No SL/TP since both are 0. One position at a time. New-bar guard using bar timestamp comparison.
